map.输入包含 &、<、>、\" 等特殊字符的文本，工具估算转义为 HTML 实体（如: Enter text containing special characters such as &, <, > and ", and the tool estimates the length increase after escaping to HTML entities (such as &), making it easy to predict how the size changes after escaping on a web page.
map.&amp; &lt; &gt; &quot; 等占 4-5 字符Unicode: & < > " and similar take 4-5 characters; the Unicode entity &#xHHHH; takes about 7-8 characters
map.模板体积评估：用户内容含大量特殊字符时转义后的存储/传输增长。: Template size assessment: the growth in storage and transmission after escaping when user content contains many special characters.
map.XSS 防护核对：确认输出编码后实体长度不影响布局截断。: XSS protection check: confirm that after output encoding the entity length does not affect layout truncation.
map.富文本存储：预估入库前转义字段宽度。: Rich text storage: estimate the escaped field width before saving to the database.
map.：转义为 \"a&amp;lt;b&amp;amp;c\"，原 6 字符变 19: : Escaped to "a&lt;b&amp;c", the original 6 characters become 19 (each special character expands into a 4-5 character entity).
map.& < > \" ' 在对应上下文需转义，防止解析错乱与 XSS。: & < > " ' must be escaped in the corresponding context to prevent parsing errors and XSS.
map.长度为何显著增加？: Why does the length increase significantly?
map.每个实体如 &amp; 占 5 字符，原文 1 字符，故含大量特殊字符时体积成倍: Each entity such as & takes 5 characters while the original takes 1, so content with many special characters grows several-fold in size.
map.HTML 实体用于页面文本安全显示，URL 编码用于传输，两者场景不同。: HTML entities are for safely displaying text on a page, while URL encoding is for transmission; the two serve different scenarios.
